description: A structure isomorphism preserves satisfaction of every scoped formula under the transported free assignment and scoped tuple.
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.StrongHomClass.realize_boundedFormula.{u, v, w, u', u_1, u_4} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w}
  {N : Type u_1} [L.Structure M] [L.Structure N] {α : Type u'} {n : ℕ} {F : Type u_4} [EquivLike F M N]
  [L.StrongHomClass F M N] (g : F) (φ : L.BoundedFormula α n) {v : α → M} {xs : Fin n → M} :
  φ.Realize (⇑g ∘ v) (⇑g ∘ xs) ↔ φ.Realize v xs
